title: 94 Corran Ard, Athy, Co. Kildare, R14 RW24
seoTitle: 94 Corran Ard, Athy, Co. Kildare, R14 RW24
description:
Sherry FitzGerald McDermott are delighted to present to the market this beautiful three bedroom family residence in this modern estate located on the outskirts of Athy Town. This stunning property is in turn key condition. Corran Ard is a mature estate just off the new Athy Town ring road. There is an array of food outlets / restaurants and public transport within close proximity.Upon entering through the hallway, is a bright and welcoming property. To the right leads into a spacious sitting room. Double doors lead into the dining area and onto the kitchen area. The kitchen looks out over a large well maintained south east facing rear garden. There is a downstairs W.C. Upstairs there are 3 spacious bedrooms (Master En-suite) which are bright and airy, 2 of the 3 bedrooms have built-in wardrobes. The stairs and landing have carpet flooring. The sliding door to the rear leads out onto a patio and pergola area.Athy is particularly well served with both primary and secondary schools. Viewing is strictly by appointment with sole selling agent Adrian Harley of Sherry FitzGerald McDermott.To see current offers or place an offer on this property, register for your mySherryFitz account at SherryFitz.ie
